Our generated terrain-test map (its Blueprint is frozen in `../../terrain-test/`) (cliffs only), opened in StarCraft II Editor 5.0.17
and edited by hand: default straight ramps added at the middle of Low Plateau's west edge
(dir 3) and south edge (dir 1), plus a diagonal ramp on the Octagon (dir 7). Saved
byte-for-byte as the Editor wrote them. The Editor only rewrote the terrain it touched, so
everything outside the ramps is still our generator's output.
